act_title: The Slum Areas (Improvement and Clearance) Act, 1956
title: Chapter not to apply to eviction of tenants from certain buildings.―Nothing in this Chapter
text:
21. Chapter not to apply to eviction of tenants from certain buildings.―Nothing in this Chapter

shall apply to or in relation to the [eviction under any law] of a tenant from any building in a slum area
belonging to the Government, [the Delhi Development Authority] or any local authority.

CHAPTER VII

MISCELLANEOUS
